parameters.name: AccessDomain
parameters.description: The backend domain name for FULLNAT address translation.

parameters.name: AccessIp
parameters.description: The backend IP address for FULLNAT address translation.

parameters.name: AccessPort
parameters.description: The backend port for FULLNAT port mapping. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: sends a dry run request. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing required parameters, invalid parameter values, and whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is granted the required authorization. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
- **false** (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the FULLNAT entry is added.

parameters.name: FullNatEntryDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the FULLNAT entry.

The description can be empty or 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: FullNatEntryName
parameters.description: The name of the FULLNAT entry. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: FullNatTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the FULLNAT table to which the FULLNAT entry belongs.

parameters.name: IpProtocol
parameters.description:
The protocol type of the Redirection Port. Valid values:

-  **TCP**: forwards TCP packets. 
-  **UDP**: forwards UDP packets.

parameters.name: NatIp
parameters.description: The NAT IP address that provides address translation.

parameters.name: NatIpPort
parameters.description:
The frontend port for FULLNAT port mapping. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly assigns an available port.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPC NAT gateway to which the FULLNAT entry belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
